description: This PHP class 'EmploymentContractModel' is part of the OrangeHRM project, representing a data model for employment contracts in the HR system API. It serializes 'EmpContract' entities for API responses, including properties like start date, end date, and contract attachment details.

classes.name: EmploymentContractModel
classes.description: A PHP class representing an API model for employment contract data, serializing EmpContract entities for API responses with specified attributes and filters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an EmpContract entity, configuring filters and attribute mappings for API serialization.
